about_blocks.text: A Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery
about_blocks.html: A Holistic Approach to Addiction Recovery

about_blocks.text: Ledgehill Treatment Centre is a leading provider of evidence-based addiction recovery treatment. They specialize in treating addiction, trauma, and mental health, using a holistic approach that aims to heal the person as a whole. The treatment programs are tailored to each client’s unique needs, incorporating individual counseling, physical exercise, and various types of therapy such as Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) and Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT). They also use 12-Step facilitation and relapse prevention to ensure long-term recovery.

about_blocks.text: Ledgehill Treatment Centre takes pride in its ability to provide long-lasting addiction recovery solutions to its clients. Their approach is based on an understanding that addiction is a complex issue that requires a multi-faceted solution. Their addiction recovery program is designed to target physical, psychological, and social factors that contribute to addiction.

about_blocks.text: Online and In-Person Addiction Recovery Programs
about_blocks.html: Online and In-Person Addiction Recovery Programs

about_blocks.text: Ledgehill Treatment Centre provides four unique programs that cater to addiction and mental health: Return to Wellness, Mood and Anxiety, Family Treatment Support, and Addiction Recovery. The programs provide intensive outpatient support that is tailored to the patient’s specific needs, and clients can access them either in-person or online.

about_blocks.text: These programs are designed to offer flexible options for those who are unable to commit to a fully-residential addiction treatment program. about_blocks.text: Finding Serenity in a Beautiful Location
about_blocks.html: Finding Serenity in a Beautiful Location

about_blocks.text: Ledgehill Treatment Centre is tucked away in the serene and picturesque area of Lawrencetown, Nova Scotia, Canada. The facility is spread over 110-acres of land that includes fields, woods, and scenic shorelines. The property is coined, “the Ledge on the hill,” and has numerous quiet places and paths to explore.
